GRADE 7 SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Self- Exploration in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explore personal abilities and interests for holistic development,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Exploration completely.
   C. Self- Exploration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Exploration.

2. About Self- Exploration around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. develop personal values for a steady personality,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Exploration completely.
   C. Self- Exploration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Exploration.

3. About Self- Exploration in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. manage emotions in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Self- Exploration completely.
   C. Self- Exploration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Self- Exploration.

5. About Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify entrepreneurial opportunities that closely match their personality,
   B. Learners should ignore Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies completely.
   C. Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.

6. About Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe requirements for social entrepreneurial opportunities in the world of work,
   B. Learners should ignore Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies completely.
   C. Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.

7. About Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify entrepreneurial opportunities that closely match their personality,
   B. Learners should ignore Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies completely.
   C. Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.

9. About Human Origin in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explore traditional stories of human origin from African communities,
   B. Learners should ignore Human Origin completely.
   C. Human Origin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Human Origin.

10. About Human Origin around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain religious stories about the origin of humankind,
   B. Learners should ignore Human Origin completely.
   C. Human Origin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Human Origin.

11. About Human Origin in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate common aspects found in traditional and religious stories of human origin,
   B. Learners should ignore Human Origin completely.
   C. Human Origin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Human Origin.

13. About Early Civilisation in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explore factors that led to the growth of the selected ancient Kingdoms in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Early Civilisation completely.
   C. Early Civilisation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early Civilisation.

14. About Early Civilisation around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. locate the selected ancient Kingdoms on a map of Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Early Civilisation completely.
   C. Early Civilisation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early Civilisation.

15. About Early Civilisation in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the contribution of ancient Kingdoms to the modern world civilisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Early Civilisation completely.
   C. Early Civilisation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Early Civilisation.

17. About Slavery and Servitude in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society,
   B. Learners should ignore Slavery and Servitude completely.
   C. Slavery and Servitude is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slavery and Servitude.

18. About Slavery and Servitude around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade,
   B. Learners should ignore Slavery and Servitude completely.
   C. Slavery and Servitude is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slavery and Servitude.

19. About Slavery and Servitude in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. sketch the geographical extent of the regions covered by the Indian Ocean slave trade in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Slavery and Servitude completely.
   C. Slavery and Servitude is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slavery and Servitude.

21. About Developments in Medium of trade in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. compare barter trade and the use of currency trade in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Developments in Medium of trade completely.
   C. Developments in Medium of trade is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Developments in Medium of trade.

22. About Developments in Medium of trade around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. trace the factors that led to the introduction of money in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Developments in Medium of trade completely.
   C. Developments in Medium of trade is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Developments in Medium of trade.

23. About Developments in Medium of trade in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. deduce the impact of the introduction of money in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Developments in Medium of trade completely.
   C. Developments in Medium of trade is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Developments in Medium of trade.

25. About Diversity and interpersonal relationships in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify factors that determine human diversity in the society,
   B. Learners should ignore Diversity and interpersonal relationships completely.
   C. Diversity and interpersonal relationships is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Diversity and interpersonal relationships.

26. About Diversity and interpersonal relationships around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain interpersonal skills that enhance healthy interactions in a multicultural society,
   B. Learners should ignore Diversity and interpersonal relationships completely.
   C. Diversity and interpersonal relationships is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Diversity and interpersonal relationships.

27. About Diversity and interpersonal relationships in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. classify the desirable and undesirable personality attributes,
   B. Learners should ignore Diversity and interpersonal relationships completely.
   C. Diversity and interpersonal relationships is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Diversity and interpersonal relationships.

29. About Peaceful Coexistence in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the qualities of a peaceful person in the community,
   B. Learners should ignore Peaceful Coexistence completely.
   C. Peaceful Coexistence is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Peaceful Coexistence.

30. About Peaceful Coexistence around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explore factors that promote peaceful co- existence,
   B. Learners should ignore Peaceful Coexistence completely.
   C. Peaceful Coexistence is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Peaceful Coexistence.

31. About Peaceful Coexistence in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. assess peaceful conflict resolution process in day- to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Peaceful Coexistence completely.
   C. Peaceful Coexistence is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Peaceful Coexistence.

33. About Historical information in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify various sources of historical information in the society,
   B. Learners should ignore Historical information completely.
   C. Historical information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historical information.

34. About Historical information around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish between primary and secondary sources of historical information,
   B. Learners should ignore Historical information completely.
   C. Historical information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historical information.

35. About Historical information in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explore how various sources of historical information have been preserved over the years,
   B. Learners should ignore Historical information completely.
   C. Historical information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historical information.

37. About Historical Development of Agriculture in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. locate areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Historical Development of Agriculture completely.
   C. Historical Development of Agriculture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historical Development of Agriculture.

38. About Historical Development of Agriculture around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explore factors that favoured growing of crops and rearing of animals in selected regions during early agriculture,
   B. Learners should ignore Historical Development of Agriculture completely.
   C. Historical Development of Agriculture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historical Development of Agriculture.

39. About Historical Development of Agriculture in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the contributions of the Nile Valley agriculture to the world civilisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Historical Development of Agriculture completely.
   C. Historical Development of Agriculture is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Historical Development of Agriculture.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Self- Exploration in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Human Origin in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Early Civilisation in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Slavery and Servitude in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Developments in Medium of trade in your school compound.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Diversity and interpersonal relationships in your school compound.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Peaceful Coexistence in your school compound.

36. Give two examples of how you can use Historical information in your school compound.

40. Give two examples of how you can use Historical Development of Agriculture in your school compound.
